question: Prithviraj III, who defeated Sultan Muhammad Ghori in 1191 was a ______ ruler.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chahamana.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Prithviraj III popularly known as Prithviraj Chauhan or Rai Pithora was a king from the Chahamana (Chauhan) dynasty.**
 
• He ruled Sapadalaksha, the traditional Chahamana territory, in present-day north-western India.
